g_aff.criterion: abs(got-ref) <= atol + rtol*abs(ref), DESIGN section 6. S per channel is the fp64 absolute sum of dy*xhat for scale and dy for bias over time then batch. For AdaIN dy includes the caller gamma+1. Compare both archived fp64 VJPs and fp64 VJPs on the same fp32-rounded operands/seed. Verify finite, nonempty, nonconstant arrays before comparison, with separately defined structural zero masks checked exactly.
g_aff.structural_zeros: dscale if every n,t contribution is identically zero because normalized x or dy is zero, dbias if all dy contributions are zero, dx on singleton or zero-scale/zero-upstream rows. Never infer structural zeros from cancellation.

g_aff_fd.step: cbrt(float64 epsilon) * max(1, L2 of the perturbed parameter) with fixed fp64 unit directions
g_aff_fd.objective: sum(g*y) / sqrt(number of upstream entries), fixed per cell
g_aff_fd.criterion: Each candidate projection and fp64 oracle projection must match all three independently computed centered fp64 differences under DESIGN section 6. Operands and upstream are pre-rounded to the candidate fp32 storage. No step adjustment.
